title: Goggles Battery Warning
description: Per-cell voltage at which the goggles' own battery warning (on-screen message + buzzer) fires. The goggles auto-detect cell count; the warning triggers when pack voltage < cells x this value. Lower thresholds are meant for Li-ion packs only. If you power your goggles with a LiPo or the original DJI battery, keep the stock setting so you are warned before discharging it too low.

per_cell_mv.title: Warn voltage per cell
per_cell_mv.description: Stock firmware uses 3.50 V/cell, which is conservative for Li-ion.
